edition.window: Orders and decisions passed or reported between 10:00 AM IST on 14 October 2026 and 11:00 AM IST on 15 October 2026

items.caseName: Bharat Ajay Jaisinghani v. Asier Metals Pvt. Ltd. & Anr.
items.coram: Justice Yogesh Khanna (Officiating Chairperson), Barun Mitra, Ajai Das Mehrotra (Technical Members)
items.headline: Polycab insolvency admission put on hold
items.text: The appellate tribunal stayed NCLT Ahmedabad's order admitting an operational creditor's insolvency plea against Polycab India. A suspended director pointed to a pre-existing dispute over payments and credit notes and offered to deposit the roughly ₹2.79 crore claimed; the deposit is to be made as a fixed deposit with the NCLAT Registrar within a week.

items.coram: Brajendra Mani Tripathi (Judicial Member), Man Mohan Gupta (Technical Member)
items.headline: Personal guarantor of Sagar Autotech sent into insolvency
items.text: The Bench admitted a Section 95 application against the personal guarantor over a debt of about ₹3.95 crore. Objections based on an expired power of attorney and limitation were rejected, the remaining complaints were treated as technicalities, and a 180-day moratorium was imposed.

items.caseName: Gagan Jhavar, Liquidator of Arya Filaments Private Limited v. Surendra Kumar Agrawal & Ors.
items.coram: Brajendra Mani Tripathi (Judicial Member), Man Mohan Gupta (Technical Member)
items.headline: Ex-resolution professional must hand records to liquidator
items.text: A former resolution professional cannot refuse records to the liquidator by saying his role has ended; the liquidation regulations reach anyone who earlier acted as RP. The suspended directors and the former RP must furnish the listed records within 30 days, with affidavits.

items.caseName: Gujarat Integrated Maritime Complex Private Limited
items.coram: Chitra Hankare (Judicial Member), Dr. V.G. Venkata Chalapathy (Technical Member)
items.headline: IL&FS subsidiary GIMCO admitted into CIRP on its own plea
items.text: The Bench admitted the IL&FS group company's Section 10 self-application as part of the composite resolution framework for IL&FS subsidiaries. A moratorium was declared and an interim resolution professional appointed.

items.caseName: Harshvardhan Lunia & Ors. v. Lendingkart Technologies Pvt. Ltd. & Ors.
items.coram: Shammi Khan (Judicial Member), Sanjeev Sharma (Technical Member)
items.headline: No forced mediation in Lendingkart oppression dispute
items.text: Minority shareholders' request to refer the oppression case to mediation was dismissed because the respondents opposed it and earlier settlement efforts had failed. The Bench said mediation depends on consent and the main petition will be decided on merits.

items.caseName: C. Janarthanan v. Notion Press Media Pvt. Ltd. & 14 Ors.
items.coram: Sanjiv Jain (Judicial Member), Venkataraman Subramaniam (Technical Member)
items.headline: ₹3.75 crore exit settlement for Notion Press shareholder approved
items.text: The Bench approved a settlement cancelling the petitioner's 3,999 shares with a matching capital reduction and a ₹3.75 crore payout. It relied on the undisputed valuation, all shareholders' consent and the absence of prejudice to creditors, and closed the oppression petition.

items.caseName: Lufthansa German Airlines v. Additional Director General (Adjudication), DGGI & Anr.
items.caseNo: Service Tax Appeal No. 50004 of 2020 and No. 50849 of 2025
items.coram: Dr. Rachna Gupta (Officiating President), P.V. Subba Rao (Technical Member)
items.headline: Airline cancellation fees are compensation, not a taxable service
items.text: Fees kept from passengers who did not travel compensate the airline for breach of the carriage contract and are not consideration for a separate service under Section 66E(e). The service tax demand was set aside; earlier payment of tax on the charges did not change their character.

items.caseName: Rissala Electric Motors (P) Ltd. v. Principal Commissioner of Customs
items.coram: Dr. Rachna Gupta (Officiating President), Hemambika R. Priya (Technical Member)
items.headline: E-scooter CKD kits without battery and charger denied duty concession
items.text: The kits were classified as complete electric two-wheelers, but the concessional rate was refused because the battery pack, charger and compressor were not imported, and the alternative benefit was not claimed in the bills of entry. The ₹54.82 lakh differential duty, confiscation and penalty were upheld.

items.headline: GST return turnover alone cannot fix a commission agent's income
items.text: A mismatch between GSTR-9C and the income tax return did not justify rejecting the books of an agricultural-produce commission agent whose agency sales were reconciled and in which no defects were found. An addition of about ₹1.97 crore was deleted.

items.bench: Karnataka Real Estate Appellate Tribunal, Bengaluru
items.caseName: Geethanjali M. v. Karnataka Real Estate Regulatory Authority & ALN Buildtech
items.coram: Justice J.M. Khazi (Chairperson), Santhosh Kumar Shetty N. (Judicial Member)
items.headline: Homebuyer must pay ₹2.45 lakh dues; compensation claims go to adjudicating officer
items.text: The appeal against K-RERA's order directing the buyer to clear outstanding dues was dismissed. Compensation claims needing detailed inquiry belong before the Adjudicating Officer, and amenity grievances before the owners' association or another forum.
